# MkPFS source subset

The `mkpfs/` directory is the command-line/core Python package copied from
PSBrew/MkPFS 1.0.0 at commit
`ce62fdc63dca02175dbb5bce45c4d7c75df6ec01`.

The unrelated CustomTkinter GUI, screenshots, project automation and upstream
tests are intentionally not vendored. No functional changes were made to the
core files. The upstream GPL-3.0 license is included as `LICENSE`.
